jobs.title: Principal Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
Radar Reinvented.

Echodyne offers the world’s first compact solid-state true beam-steering radar for a wide range of industries and applications. Our high-performance radars work in all weather and are designed for autonomous vehicles, uncrewed aircraft & drones, and security of borders, critical infrastructure, and smart cities. The company combines the patented technology of metamaterials with powerful software to create a radar sensor with unprecedented performance at commercial price points. Echodyne offers its radars to companies working in Automotive, Transportation, Critical Infrastructure Protection, Border Security, Smart Cities, Uncrewed Aircraft Systems (UAS), and Airspace Management including Urban Air Mobility (UTM).

Echodyne is seeking a Principal Technical Program Manager with experience in hardware and software product development to join our team working in a fast-paced environment developing high-performance commercial radar solutions.

ROLE OVERVIEW

As a Principal Technical Program Manager, you will have a critical role in Echodyne’s relentless pursuit of delivering industry best advanced radar solutions to our customers.  You will lead cross functional teams to develop products that contribute to meeting Echodyne’s business growth objectives.  The scope of this role includes development of a variety of hardware/software products.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Deliver innovative products and solutions that exceed customer expectations and advance Echodyne’s core technology differentiation

- Define, plan, and manage complex development programs

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including software developers, mechanical engineers, electrical engineers, systems engineers, radar scientists, manufacturing engineers and sourcing

- Track and report program status and metrics

- Drive continuous improvements in product development methodologies

REQUIRED SKILLS / EXPERIENCE

- Ability to identify solutions to challenging problems that optimize results for Echodyne and our customers

- Ability to weigh risks and make clear decisions based on available information

- Ability to lead engineering and research teams to achieve objectives

- Experience leading hardware development programs

- Experience leading development programs in collaboration with customers and partners

DESIRED SKILLS / EXPERIENCE
(Looking for one or more as a complement to the core skills)

- Experience leading embedded software and hardware development programs

- Experience using Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) tools or software

- Experience using project management tools, such as MS Project, MS Excel, and JIRA

- Experience in Agile or hybrid waterfall-Agile software development methodologies

- Strong communication and presentations skills

- Building collaborative relationships both internally and externally

QUALIFICATIONS

- Bachelor's degree in engineering, other technical degree, or equivalent work experience

- 5 years or more in technical program management

Echodyne’s technology is export controlled by the U.S. Government and we must evaluate an applicant’s eligibility to handle export-controlled information or obtain required Government authorizations.  Therefore, we will ask you as part of the application process to identify whether you are a U.S. Citizen or green card holder, or have asylum/refugee status in the U.S.

WHAT WE OFFER

This is an exempt role.
The expected annual salary range for this role is
$149,659 — $224,437 USD

If your skills generally align but not perfectly, please apply anyway. There may be another role that’s a great fit for you!

We offer competitive compensation and benefits to our full-time, US-based employees, including:

- RSU (Restricted Stock Units)

- Generous Benefits:

- Fully-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance premiums for you

- Choice of PPO or HDHP/HSA

- Virtual Care – 98Point6

- Employee Assistance Program

- Mental Health coverage through Springhealth & Talkspace (Premera)

- Travel Assistance Insurance

- Company Paid Life Insurance

- Company Paid Short & Long Term Disability

- Flexible PTO (exempt) / 15 days per year (non-exempt)

- 401(k) match

- Pet Insurance

- Prepaid Legal Program

- Commuter Benefits

- Paid Company Holidays

All qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, age, status as a protected veteran or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Principal Technical Program Manager – Technology, Process, and Supplier Development (TPD)
jobs.description:
Radar Reinvented.

Echodyne offers the world’s first compact solid-state true beam-steering radar for a wide range of industries and applications. Our high-performance radars work in all weather and are designed for autonomous vehicles, uncrewed aircraft & drones, and security of borders, critical infrastructure, and smart cities. The company combines the patented technology of metamaterials with powerful software to create a radar sensor with unprecedented performance at commercial price points. Echodyne offers its radars to companies working in Automotive, Transportation, Critical Infrastructure Protection, Border Security, Smart Cities, Uncrewed Aircraft Systems (UAS), and Airspace Management including Urban Air Mobility (UTM).

Echodyne is seeking a Principal Technical Program Manager with experience leading supplier-driven hardware and technology integration programs to join our Program Management Office (PMO).

ROLE OVERVIEW

You’ll play a critical role in the development and maturation of custom, made-to-specification assemblies, components, and technologies that support the company’s long-term product roadmap. This role bridges engineering, operations, sourcing, and external partners to deliver next-generation radar and sensing platforms.

You will lead strategic initiatives involving early-stage R&D, supplier development, and process optimization—often running in parallel with or ahead of standard product programs. The ideal candidate brings a systems mindset, deep technical fluency, and a strong background in managing complex cross-functional efforts with both internal and external teams.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Lead and execute cross-functional initiatives involving made-to-spec hardware, components, and processes across supplier and internal engineering teams

- Define and manage comprehensive development plans, integrating technical milestones, supplier readiness, and risk mitigation

- Drive technology feasibility reviews and supplier evaluations, partnering with engineering and sourcing teams to qualify new capabilities

- Oversee integration of custom supplier deliverables into internal development efforts, ensuring alignment on quality, timing, and validation

- Assess and mature supplier processes, capabilities, and metrics to ensure repeatable, scalable development

- Promote structured collaboration and alignment across engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing teams

- Lead post-integration reviews to drive continuous improvement in internal and external processes

- Support strategic planning by identifying technical capability gaps, supplier dependencies, and future readiness requirements

- Travel domestically and internationally for supplier site visits, technical reviews, and onboarding activities (estimated 15–25%

REQUIRED SKILLS / EXPERIENCE

- Proven ability to lead complex, multistakeholder development programs involving custom or emerging technologies

- Experience driving supplier qualification, onboarding, and development efforts for hardware components or assemblies

- Strong understanding of hardware development lifecycles, design-for-manufacturing principles, and supplier engagement models

- Highly proficient in building and managing integrated project plans, tracking risk and performance, and driving execution through influence

- Excellent communication and documentation skills; able to translate complex requirements across technical and nontechnical stakeholders

- Strong organizational awareness and ability to manage ambiguity in fast-paced environments

DESIRED SKILLS / EXPERIENCE
(Looking for one or more as a complement to the core skills)

- Background in radar, RF systems, aerospace, automotive, or complex electromechanical systems

- Familiarity with Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) tools such as Arena or Windchill

- Proficiency with project management and collaboration tools (e.g., MS Project, Confluence, Jira)

- Experience with Agile or hybrid program execution models

- Certifications such as PMP, Lean Six Sigma, or equivalent are a plus

- Experience driving process or framework improvements across internal and supplier teams

QUALIFICATIONS

- Bachelor’s degree in engineering, physical sciences, supply chain, or a related technical discipline

- 8+ years in technical program management, supplier development, or complex hardware integration

- Ability to travel up to 25%, including internationally, for supplier engagement and coordination activities

jobs.description:
Radar Reinvented.

Echodyne offers the world’s first compact solid-state true beam-steering radar for a wide range of industries and applications. Our high-performance radars work in all weather and are designed for autonomous vehicles, uncrewed aircraft & drones, and security of borders, critical infrastructure, and smart cities. The company combines the patented technology of metamaterials with powerful software to create a radar sensor with unprecedented performance at commercial price points. Echodyne offers its radars to companies working in Automotive, Transportation, Critical Infrastructure Protection, Border Security, Smart Cities, Uncrewed Aircraft Systems (UAS), and Airspace Management including Urban Air Mobility (UTM).

Echodyne is seeking a Product Manager to join our fast-growing team.

ROLE OVERVIEW

Echodyne is seeking a Product Manager to support the development and delivery of EchoWare, our radar software product.  This role turns established product priorities into clear, actionable work for Engineering and helps ensure delivered functionality meets product requirements.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Break product requirements and epics into well-scoped user stories with clear workflows, edge cases and testable acceptable criteria.

- Maintain and prioritize the EchoWare backlog in Jira, keeping upcoming work ready for development and aligned with established product and release priorities.

- Lead backlog refinement with Engineering and sequence work around priorities and technical dependencies.

- Serve as the day-to-day Product contact during development, resolving requirements questions and documenting decisions and changes.

- Make tactical product decisions within established direction; escalate changes affecting scope, priorities, product intent, or customer commitments.

- Partner with Engineering, UX, and Test to resolve tradeoffs, agree on what done means, and validate delivered functionality against requirements.

- Capture defects, limitations, and follow-up work and bring customer and field feedback back to the Product team.

- Build working knowledge of EchoWare, customer workflows, integrations, and operational use cases to inform product decisions.

REQUIRED SKILLS / EXPERIENCE

- 2+ years of experience in product management, product ownership, or a related software product role.

- Experience working with software engineering teams through development and release.

- Ability to translate product requirements into clear user stories and testable acceptance criteria.

- Experience maintaining and refining product backlogs in Jira or a similar tool.

- Working knowledge of Agile development practices and the ability to understand technical tradeoffs and dependencies.

- Strong written and verbal communication with excellent attention to detail.

- Ability to operate effectively in a technical, fast-moving environment with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities.

DESIRED SKILLS / EXPERIENCE

- Familiarity with radar, sensor software, defense, security, or airspace management applications.
